decisions.summary: The record is written and checked by fresh page sessions from two briefs (write, then check-and-apply); one question; new registry keys only where a source is found and cited.
decisions.why: A process choice for FR-001/FR-002; it drops no part of the search or the record the request and spec ask for.

decisions.summary: The ten claims FR-003 lists, found by its recorded search with its five stated exclusions, are edited after the record lands (docstring Research: lines only), bundled with make claims-bundle, judged by impl-drift, verdicts recorded with make claims-checked.
decisions.why: Carries FR-003 exactly (the ten units and five exclusions the round-3 verdict confirmed) and FR-004 (no engine line); this is the request's 'update the implementation's tagging so that it shows up on the claims report'.

decisions.summary: Search the archive then the web, in Chinese and Japanese, for whether a lane or path ran between a farmhouse and its own homestead grove or dooryard copse; record the answer or an absence naming each search on 0036's findings page; its drawing page states how our maps settle it (feature 287 woods W25).
decisions.why: FR-001/FR-002 as written; 'in Chinese and Japanese' adds search languages alongside the two regions FR-001 names and excludes nothing, and the drawing-page sentence is the record's own form for a rendering decision, not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: make record-owed after the write; the check session dispatches every owed record check from its bundle and answers each.
decisions.why: FR-002's 'the record's checks owed by the change are answered'.

decisions.summary: Each listed claim is rewritten to cite 0036's findings page (keeping its current citations) in the finding's terms; a detail the finding does not reach stays a labeled guess citing 0036's absence; one impl-drift pass; MISLABELED relabeled and re-checked; DRIFTED recorded, not fixed.
decisions.why: FR-003 word for word, including its guess carve-out, which the accepted spec already carries; recording DRIFTED without a fix is FR-004 and the GM's 'or which is not implemented in accordance with our research'.

decisions.summary: If no unit keeps a lane out of the gap between a house and its own seats, implementation-check.md records it as implemented nowhere with the search; make impl-check F=352 reports nothing missing.
decisions.why: FR-003's last sentence and FR-005. The conditional names the one part of the question the spec singles out; FR-003's 'any part of the question no code decides' still governs and impl-check is the backstop, so nothing is dropped.

decisions.summary: Project Structure: 0036's findings, notes and drawing pages; the ten engine files of FR-003's units (docstring claims only); the two briefs.
decisions.why: The ten files match FR-003's ten units one for one (all exist in the clone); the round-3 aside (Technical Context and Project Structure predating round 2) is resolved. implementation-check.md, conditional on D4, is not listed, which omits no scope since D4 states it.
